old_text:
Zinedine Zidane to be officially introduced as France head coach
Issued on:
More than 120 journalists and photographers are expected at the headquarters of the French Football Federation for the presentation of Zinédine Zidane as manager of the French national team.
Italian football is sinking deeper into crisis. Vinicius Jr could be leaving Real Madrid. In tennis, several French players have made a big leap up the ATP rankings. Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs have resumed training.

Issued on:
